name: Chalonese Advanced Spot Fading Glow Cream | Brightening Face Cream with Niacinamide, Alpha-Arbutin & Tranexamic Acid | Dark Spot & Uneven Skin Tone Care | 20g
description:
Give your skin a brighter, smoother, and more radiant-looking appearance with Chalonese Advanced Spot Fading Glow Cream. Formulated with Niacinamide, Alpha-Arbutin, Tranexamic Acid, Sodium Hyaluronate, Allantoin, and Licorice Root Extract, this daily skincare cream helps improve the appearance of dark spots, dullness, and uneven-looking skin tone while supporting a soft, hydrated, and healthy-looking complexion. Its lightweight, smooth texture spreads easily over the skin, making it suitable for incorporating into a regular daily skincare routine.

Key Features
Formulated with Niacinamide for daily skin-conditioning care
Contains Alpha-Arbutin to support a brighter-looking complexion
Enriched with Tranexamic Acid for targeted dark spot care
Helps improve the appearance of visible dark spots and uneven skin tone
Helps brighten dull and tired-looking skin
Contains Sodium Hyaluronate to support hydrated-looking skin
Formulated with Allantoin for skin-conditioning care
Contains Licorice Root Extract and botanical extracts
Helps promote a smoother and more radiant-looking complexion
Lightweight and easy to apply
Suitable for regular daily skincare routines
